title: SPY-TERMINAL - KEYLESS/OPEN SOURCE
features:
SPYTERMINAL v11 — Feature list & Changelog
==========================================

FEATURE LIST (v11)
------------------
The best alternative to the Roblox native console. No more copying line by line! Select everything at once.

- Text Selection (select + copy logs; view freezes when you scroll up or click into the log)
- Log Interception (captures all LogService messages in real time)
- Log History Pull (recent logs loaded on startup via GetLogHistory — console starts populated)
- Log Dedup (consecutive identical logs collapsed with [xN] counter)
- Max 800 logs / 180,000 chars (dual buffer limit, oldest entries trimmed first)
- Plain-Text Logs (clean ASCII prefixes [INFO] [WARN] [ERR!] [OUT] >> ; RichText off so Ctrl+C copy stays clean)
- DELETE toggle (show/hide), ESC to close (first ESC blurs a focused field, second ESC closes)
- Ctrl+L clear, Ctrl+F focus search
- Slide animation (slides in/out from screen edge on open/close)
- Drop Shadow (3-layer soft shadow behind the console frame)
- Search Bar (live filter with debounce, case-insensitive)
- Filter Buttons (All, Info, Warn, Err)
- Timestamp Toggle (Ts button — show/hide timestamps per line)
- Log Counter (visible/total logs)
- Follow / Auto-Scroll (toggle on/off; auto-disabled when you click/scroll the log, with a "↓ N new" indicator; one click resumes)
- Pause Capture (Live/Paused — drops incoming external logs without closing)
- Lua Eval (execute Lua in the bottom bar, Enter to run; loadstring-guarded)
- Eval History (up/down navigation, up to 50 entries, no top duplicates)
- Eval History Indicator (shows current index e.g. "2/12" while navigating)
- Copy All (copies visible logs to clipboard)
- Clear (clears all logs with green flash feedback)
- Hover Tooltips (floating hint that follows the cursor on all buttons)
- TopBar Dividers (visual separators between button groups)
- Settings Panel (header label + position presets + font scale rows)
- Position Presets (TopLeft, TopRight, BottomLeft, BottomRight, Center, Draggable)
- Drag Mode (Draggable preset: drag from top bar; position restored correctly after hide/show)
- Resize Handle (resizable from 320x200 to 2000x1200; size preserved after hide/show)
- Console Font Scale (log font size x0.5 – x1.5)
- Menu Font Scale (UI font size x0.5 – x1.5)
- Title Status Dot (green=live, red=paused, yellow=not-following; version badge)
- Double-Execution Guard (blocks re-run in same session; rejoin to re-execute)
